summary: Add disabled-by-default native objective-fault routing for the durable GET agents performance window.

replay.detail: When explicitly configured, completed conclusive performance cuts enter a durable local outbox and replay through the existing native objective-fault Store. Each missed cut reaches the production native sender before a later queued recovery can resolve it, including after restart. Retried cuts reuse the native failure episode and do not duplicate notices.

schema.detail: The separate host-local performance ledger gains fault outbox, quarantine and overflow tables. The graph database schema version is unchanged.

rules.detail: An opt-in member/reviewer binding routes a missed complete seven-day window to the configured native reviewer. A met window recovers the same episode. Unknown or incomplete windows do not alter native faults; no binding is enabled by default.

compatibility.detail: The optional agents_request_slo_fault setting binds the local member and a declared agent reviewer. Existing deployments without the setting continue measuring without sending faults. Doctor performance output gains fault delivery health fields.

downtime.detail: No additional service interruption beyond the normal binary rollout.

manual.detail: Keep routing disabled until the member/reviewer assignment has been reviewed and a complete durable window exists. Enabling is a separate configuration decision; this change does not enable the Factory assignment.

recovery.detail: Removing the optional binding pauses fault admission and delivery without dropping pending cuts. Binding changes and clock rewinds quarantine affected cuts; overflow is latched for operator reconciliation. Binary rollback leaves the additional local ledger tables unused.
